scholarships.title: UT Austin International Student Scholarships and Financial Services (Texas Global / ISSS)
scholarships.official_source: Texas Global / International Student and Scholar Services, The University of Texas at Austin

existing.funding_period: one-time award per semester or academic year
eligibility: Enrolled full-time at UT Austin during the award semester (most awards)
Completed an entire course of study for two academic semesters at UT Austin (General ISSS Financial Aid, SIAWE, Jerry D. Wilcox, African Leadership Bridge)
Minimum cumulative GPA set per award, ranging from 2.0 to 3.75
Demonstrated financial need for the need-based awards
Country or region of origin conditions for the Carlos and Clara Quintanilla, Dr. David Nilsson, SIAWE, TAMS, Good Neighbor, African Leadership Bridge, Iimura Peace, Khalid Alhilali and STEM awards
existing.eligibility_summary: International students already enrolled full-time at UT Austin, or admitted/continuing students, who meet the award-specific criteria. Most awards require completion of two academic semesters at UT, a minimum GPA between 2.0 and 3.75, and demonstrated financial need; several are restricted by nationality, preparatory education or region of origin.
benefits: Nonresident tuition waivers or exemptions for TAMS and the African Leadership Bridge award
One-year tuition exemption for Good Neighbor Scholarship recipients
coverage: One-time cash awards ranging from USD 2,000 to USD 5,000 per award
Tuition Assistance for Mexican Students: waiver of the nonresident portion of tuition, not a cash award
Good Neighbor Scholarship: exemption of one year's worth of tuition (fall, spring and summer), excluding fees and charges such as health insurance and the ISSS Support Services fee
African Leadership Bridge: $5,000 academic year award with a tuition waiver of the nonresident portion, split $2,500 fall and $2,500 spring
requirements: Apply through the LASSO university-wide scholarship system
Meet all eligibility criteria for the specific scholarship
Be prepared to answer questions about estimated annual expenses and to write essays
documents: Completed LASSO scholarship application found by keyword search 'ISSS'
Essays related to the scholarship's intent or the applicant's own experiences and background
UT Austin enrolment record proving full-time status and completed semesters
application_method: Log in to LASSO with a UT Austin account
Search for scholarships using the keyword 'ISSS'
Open the desired application and click 'Start Application' or 'Continue Application'
Submit before the deadline for that cycle
existing.selection_notes: Awards are competitive and the number allotted per semester is limited. Scholarships are one-time awards and recipients are not guaranteed to receive them in subsequent years.
existing.best_fit: Already-enrolled international undergraduates and graduates at UT Austin with at least two completed semesters who meet a specific award's nationality, region-of-origin or financial-need criteria.
existing.notes: General ISSS Financial Aid explicitly does not provide a waiver of the nonresident portion of tuition and fees, and is limited to formula-funded (Option I) courses; Option III students are not eligible. All cash awards are applied automatically to outstanding UT debts, and 14% is withheld for tax unless a treaty applies.
existing.duration: One-time awards for the semester or academic year in which they are granted; recipients are not guaranteed to receive the scholarship in subsequent years.
existing.application_period: Twice yearly: Spring/Summer term scholarships October 1 - November 1, and Fall/Academic Year scholarships February 1 - March 1.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 scholarships will be accepted October 1, 2026 - November 1, 2026. Applications for Fall 2027 and 2027-2028 academic year scholarships will be accepted February 1, 2027 - March 1, 2027.
existing.program_type: University-administered needs-based, merit-based and country-restricted scholarships, cash awards and tuition exemptions for enrolled international students.
